case-23.zh-Hans:
使用@音频1《Zero to Pop》作为唯一音乐、节拍和口型依据，生成一支30秒、16:9、24fps的原创单人K-POP MV。

视频必须完整覆盖音频的0.00–30.00秒，不得截断、延长、变速或自动淡出。不要重新生成背景音乐，不要加入另一首歌曲。

全片只有@图1是主角和主唱。允许出现2—6名伴舞，但伴舞不能获得面部特写、不能对口型、不能遮挡主角或成为第二视觉中心。

主角的脸、发型、发色、身材比例、服装和饰品全程锁定。只有主角按照@音频1中的实际人声精确对口型；没有人声的段落保持闭唇表演。

【整体视觉】

高预算真人K-POP MV，结合Y2K未来主义、怪诞糖果世界和千禧年数字文化：

CRT电子宠物、透明翻盖手机、像素图标、果冻便利店、充气卧室、镭射洗车通道、巨型CD舞台、镀铬金属、透明塑料和CD彩虹衍射。

色彩以泡泡糖粉、电光蓝、蓝莓紫、酸性绿和镀铬银为主。

怪诞元素必须像真正搭建的实景、机械装置和高级视觉特效，不能像廉价AI拼贴、普通夜店或传统赛博朋克城市。

【主角造型】

主角穿原创Y2K未来女团服装：

银白色不对称短夹克、糖果粉亮片内搭、蓝紫渐变低腰工装裤、透明树脂腰带、镀铬圆环饰品、银白厚底运动鞋，以及一个迷你透明翻盖手机挂饰。

服装全程不变。金属、塑料、布料、头发和饰品必须表现真实重量、反光、惯性和自然摆动。

【音频同步原则】

歌曲约128 BPM，每个主节拍间隔约0.469秒。

最重要的画面锁点：

2.78秒：第一个强重拍，正式进入舞蹈。
6.06秒：第一次换景。
9.82秒：进入翻盖手机表演镜头。
12.63秒：进入第一段收束动作。
14.02秒：音乐明显降能量，切入失重卧室。
17.78秒：节奏重新启动。
21.07秒：高潮副歌和巨型CD舞台出现。
24.82秒：音乐突然抽空，伴舞冻结。
28.95秒：最后一句和最终特写。
29.90—30.00秒：翻盖手机合上，画面硬停。

所有剪辑、甩发、转身、手势、踩地、队形变化和摄影机冲击都必须落在@音频1的真实重拍上。

【逐秒镜头时间线】

0.00–0.47秒：

黑暗中出现一条细窄的CRT扫描线，随歌曲第一个电子启动声闪亮。

不要出现人物，不要添加片名或文字。

0.47–1.88秒：

扫描线展开为一台圆角CRT显示器。

屏幕内出现一只原创像素电子宠物。它随着音频中的电子声睁开眼睛，头顶依次跳出像素爱心、电池和小星星。

所有图标只使用抽象像素图形，不要出现品牌、角色或乱码文字。

1.88–2.78秒：

摄影机快速从CRT屏幕中后退，揭示完整的半透明粉色街机房。

主角已经站在CRT前，侧身背对镜头。摄影机停稳时，她缓慢回头，眼神锁定镜头。

她必须在2.78秒第一个强重拍准确击中开场姿势。

2.78–6.06秒：

低机位鱼眼单人中近景。

主角进入第一段独舞：按键式手指动作、肩部弹动、手臂波浪、髋部重心切换和一次快速半转。

所有动作根据@音频1逐拍执行，不要机械地平均分配动作。

主角按照实际人声自然对口型。背景CRT里的像素宠物同步模仿她的节奏，但不能变成人类或复制她的脸。

摄影机围绕主角移动约45度，同时缓慢推进。

6.06秒，主角手掌拍向镜头，形成遮挡式硬切。

6.06–9.82秒：

进入外星果冻便利店。

主角站在粉色自动传送带中央，4名伴舞从两侧货架后滑入，形成主角在最前方的V形队列。

五人完成连续行进编舞：两步滑行、交叉手臂、肩部撞击、一次同步下沉和快速回弹。

主角距离摄影机最近，服装颜色最鲜明，面部始终清晰。伴舞动作统一但幅度略小。

摄影机正面后退，与传送带保持相同速度。

9.82–12.63秒：

中长焦主角单人镜头。

伴舞退到背景并失焦。主角从货架上拿起一只巨大的透明果冻翻盖手机。

她对着手机完成歌曲中这一段的实际对口型，通过眼神和嘴角表现出俏皮、略带嫌弃的态度。

手机按键根据音乐节拍发光。摄影机在强音上做两次短促punch zoom，但不改变主角身份或面部结构。

12.63–14.02秒：

切回全身镜头。

主角把果冻手机抛向空中，4名伴舞重新进入队形。

全员在三个主要节拍上依次完成：

第一拍：双臂向外展开；
第二拍：快速转身并甩发；
第三拍：身体下沉后锐利定格。

主角踩亮地面上的圆形像素按钮。一道蓝紫色扫描光从脚底向上扫过所有人物。

14.02秒，音乐降能量的瞬间完成场景转换。

14.02–15.55秒：

进入淡紫色失重充气卧室。

画面由快速舞蹈突然转为稳定、梦幻的长镜头。主角坐在充气床边，房间和家具开始缓慢旋转，但主角仍保持正常垂直方向。

不出现伴舞。

摄影机缓慢靠近。主角根据实际音频进行克制、贴近耳语感的对口型，不做大幅度舞蹈。

透明枕头、小型CD和银色耳机线缓慢漂浮。

15.55–17.78秒：

主角从床边站起，向摄影机走来。

两名伴舞出现在旋转房间的左右墙面，制造重力方向错乱的视觉效果，但不能抢夺主角注意力。

主角伸手触碰一张漂浮的小型CD。CD逐渐膨胀为彩虹色圆形入口。

17.78秒节奏重新出现时，主角迈步穿过CD入口，摄影机紧随她穿过，形成无缝转场。

17.78–21.07秒：

进入镭射泡泡洗车隧道。

节奏重新启动，主角带领4名伴舞向前完成行进式编舞：强力踏步、交叉手臂、头部转向、肩部重击和左右展开队形。

镀铬拱门、粉蓝旋转软刷和彩灯按照真实节拍运动。透明泡泡从人物之间经过，但不得遮挡主角面部。

摄影机在主角正前方快速后退，主角始终位于中心。

20.60–21.07秒之间，主角踢向一个巨大的透明泡泡。泡泡表面转化为CD彩虹纹理。

21.07秒高潮重拍时，泡泡爆开并完成换景。

21.07–24.82秒：

进入巨型CD终章舞台，这是全片能量最高的段落。

主角站在直径12米的旋转CD中心，6名伴舞组成对称半圆。摄影机从高位快速下降至略低于腰部的英雄角度。

主角按照歌曲高潮段落精确对口型，全员完成副歌核心编舞：

两拍快速手臂切换；
一次髋部重击；
一次同步旋转；
一次全身下沉；
最后伴舞向两侧打开，把舞台中心完全让给主角。

摄影机在主角旋转时绕行半圈，但不能越过轴线或造成左右翻转。

CD表面产生真实彩虹衍射，像素星空和镀铬行星随节奏闪动。

24.82秒音乐突然抽空时，所有伴舞立刻冻结。

24.82–27.00秒：

主角继续保持运动，伴舞像卡顿的电子游戏角色一样定格在背景。

主角独自向摄影机走两步。画面根据音频中的断奏出现克制的数字卡顿效果：同一个动作短暂重复1—2帧，但主角面部保持稳定。

随着音乐继续变空，冻结的伴舞依次化为方形像素颗粒并消失。

主角不得消失、复制或变形。

27.00–28.95秒：

舞台上只剩主角。

巨型CD停止旋转，背景灯光大部分熄灭。摄影机缓慢推近主角面部。

主角取下腰间的迷你透明翻盖手机，将它举到脸旁。她保持闭唇，直到@音频1最后一句人声真正开始。

画面运动变得极简，把注意力完全留给最后一句和主角表情。

28.95–29.90秒：

主角精确对口型歌曲最后一句。

她直视镜头，从冷静表情逐渐变成带有恶作剧感的轻微笑容。摄影机继续推进至面部特写。

只保留银粉色轮廓光和眼睛里的小型方形反光。

29.90–30.00秒：

主角"啪"地合上翻盖手机。

合盖动作必须与歌曲最终收尾音完全同步。背景灯光瞬间熄灭，画面硬切为黑色。

不要淡出，不要延长尾音，不要字幕、Logo或额外结束镜头。

【表演与口型】

只允许主角对口型。口型必须依据@音频1中的真实语音和节奏生成，不要根据文字自行猜测，不要在纯器乐段随机张嘴。

主角在快速舞蹈时仍保持自然呼吸、面部肌肉运动和稳定身份。表情变化需要与音乐能量一致：

前半段俏皮、自信；
14.02秒后变得梦幻、克制；
17.78秒重新充满力量；
21.07秒进入主打歌级舞台状态；
24.82秒后变得冷静、带恶作剧感。

【硬性限制】

不得改变@音频1的速度、结构或长度。
不得加入新的背景音乐、对白或无关人声。
音效只能作为非常轻微的视觉反馈，不能覆盖原曲。
主角从第一帧到最后一帧必须保持同一张脸。
不得生成主角克隆体或第二名主唱。
伴舞最多6名，面孔必须互不相同。
禁止人物融合、额外肢体、畸形手指、脚底漂移、错误倒影、服装突变和随机换景。
禁止乱码文字、品牌、商标、字幕和水印。
case-23.en:
Use @Audio 1 "Zero to Pop" as the sole music, beat, and lip-sync basis, and generate a 30-second, 16:9, 24fps original solo K-POP MV.

The video must fully cover 0.00–30.00 seconds of the audio, and must not be truncated, extended, speed-changed, or automatically faded out. Do not regenerate background music, and do not add another song.

Throughout the entire video, only @Image 1 is the protagonist and lead vocalist. 2–6 backup dancers are allowed, but the backup dancers must not receive facial close-ups, must not lip-sync, must not block the protagonist, and must not become a second visual center.

The protagonist's face, hairstyle, hair color, body proportions, clothing, and accessories are locked throughout. Only the protagonist lip-syncs precisely according to the actual vocals in @Audio 1; during sections with no vocals, she keeps her lips closed in performance.

[Overall visual]

High-budget live-action K-POP MV, combining Y2K futurism, a bizarre candy world, and millennium digital culture:

CRT virtual pets, transparent flip phones, pixel icons, jelly convenience stores, inflatable bedrooms, laser car wash tunnels, giant CD stages, chrome metal, transparent plastic, and CD rainbow diffraction.

Colors are mainly bubblegum pink, electric blue, blueberry purple, acid green, and chrome silver.

The bizarre elements must look like genuinely built practical sets, mechanical installations, and high-end visual effects, and must not look like cheap AI collage, ordinary nightclubs, or traditional cyberpunk cities.

[Protagonist styling]

The protagonist wears an original Y2K futuristic girl-group outfit:

silver-white asymmetrical cropped jacket, candy-pink sequined inner top, blue-purple gradient low-rise cargo pants, transparent resin belt, chrome ring accessories, silver-white platform sneakers, and a mini transparent flip-phone charm.

The clothing remains unchanged throughout. Metal, plastic, fabric, hair, and accessories must show real weight, reflections, inertia, and natural sway.

[Audio synchronization principles]

The song is about 128 BPM, with each main beat interval of about 0.469 seconds.

The most important visual lock points:

2.78 seconds: the first strong downbeat, formally entering the dance.
6.06 seconds: the first scene change.
9.82 seconds: entering the flip-phone performance shot.
12.63 seconds: entering the first closing movement section.
14.02 seconds: the music noticeably drops energy, cutting into the weightless bedroom.
17.78 seconds: the rhythm restarts.
21.07 seconds: the climax chorus and giant CD stage appear.
24.82 seconds: the music suddenly empties out, and the backup dancers freeze.
28.95 seconds: the last line and final close-up.
29.90–30.00 seconds: the flip phone closes, and the image hard-stops.

All cuts, hair whips, turns, gestures, foot stomps, formation changes, and camera impacts must land on the real downbeats of @Audio 1.

[Second-by-second shot timeline]

0.00–0.47 seconds:

A thin narrow CRT scan line appears in the darkness, flashing with the song's first electronic startup sound.

Do not show characters, and do not add a title or text.

0.47–1.88 seconds:

The scan line expands into a rounded CRT monitor.

Inside the screen appears an original pixel virtual pet. It opens its eyes with the electronic sound in the audio, and pixel hearts, batteries, and small stars pop out above its head in sequence.

All icons use only abstract pixel graphics; do not show brands, characters, or garbled text.

1.88–2.78 seconds:

The camera quickly pulls back from the CRT screen, revealing the complete translucent pink arcade room.

The protagonist is already standing in front of the CRT, turned sideways with her back to the camera. When the camera stops steadily, she slowly turns her head back, her gaze locking onto the camera.

She must accurately hit the opening pose on the first strong downbeat at 2.78 seconds.

2.78–6.06 seconds:

Low-angle fisheye solo medium-close shot.

The protagonist enters the first solo dance section: button-press finger movements, shoulder bounces, arm waves, hip weight shifts, and one quick half-turn.

All movements are executed beat by beat according to @Audio 1; do not mechanically distribute movements evenly.

The protagonist lip-syncs naturally according to the actual vocals. The pixel pet in the background CRT synchronously imitates her rhythm, but must not turn into a human or copy her face.

The camera moves about 45 degrees around the protagonist while slowly pushing in.

At 6.06 seconds, the protagonist slaps her palm toward the camera, creating an occlusion hard cut.

6.06–9.82 seconds:

Enter the alien jelly convenience store.

The protagonist stands in the center of a pink automatic conveyor belt, and 4 backup dancers slide in from behind the shelves on both sides, forming a V-shaped formation with the protagonist at the very front.

The five people complete a continuous traveling choreography: two sliding steps, crossed arms, shoulder bumps, one synchronized sink, and a quick rebound.

The protagonist is closest to the camera, her clothing colors are the most vivid, and her face is always clear. The backup dancers' movements are uniform but slightly smaller in amplitude.

The camera retreats from the front at the same speed as the conveyor belt.

9.82–12.63 seconds:

Medium-long-lens solo shot of the protagonist.

The backup dancers retreat into the background and go out of focus. The protagonist picks up a giant transparent jelly flip phone from the shelf.

She completes the actual lip-sync for this section of the song toward the phone, expressing a playful, slightly disgusted attitude through her eyes and the corners of her mouth.

The phone keys glow according to the musical beat. The camera performs two short punch zooms on strong accents, but does not change the protagonist's identity or facial structure.

12.63–14.02 seconds:

Cut back to a full-body shot.

The protagonist throws the jelly phone into the air, and the 4 backup dancers re-enter the formation.

Everyone completes in sequence on three main beats:

First beat: both arms spread outward;
Second beat: quick turn and hair whip;
Third beat: body sinks and then sharply freezes.

The protagonist steps on and lights up a circular pixel button on the floor. A blue-purple scanning light sweeps upward from the soles of the feet over all the people.

At 14.02 seconds, the scene transition is completed at the moment the music drops energy.

14.02–15.55 seconds:

Enter the pale purple weightless inflatable bedroom.

The image suddenly changes from fast dancing to a stable, dreamlike long take. The protagonist sits by the inflatable bed, and the room and furniture begin to rotate slowly, but the protagonist still maintains a normal vertical orientation.

No backup dancers appear.

The camera slowly approaches. The protagonist performs restrained, whisper-like lip-sync according to the actual audio, without large dance movements.

Transparent pillows, small CDs, and silver earphone wires float slowly.

15.55–17.78 seconds:

The protagonist stands up from the bedside and walks toward the camera.

Two backup dancers appear on the left and right walls of the rotating room, creating a visual effect of disordered gravity direction, but they must not steal the protagonist's attention.

The protagonist reaches out and touches a small floating CD. The CD gradually expands into a rainbow-colored circular entrance.

When the rhythm reappears at 17.78 seconds, the protagonist steps through the CD entrance, and the camera closely follows her through, forming a seamless transition.

17.78–21.07 seconds:

Enter the laser bubble car wash tunnel.

The rhythm restarts, and the protagonist leads 4 backup dancers forward in traveling choreography: powerful stomps, crossed arms, head turns, shoulder hits, and left-right spreading formations.

Chrome arches, pink-blue rotating soft brushes, and colored lights move according to the real beat. Transparent bubbles pass between the people, but must not block the protagonist's face.

The camera quickly retreats directly in front of the protagonist, and the protagonist always remains in the center.

Between 20.60–21.07 seconds, the protagonist kicks a giant transparent bubble. The bubble surface transforms into a CD rainbow texture.

On the climax downbeat at 21.07 seconds, the bubble bursts and completes the scene change.

21.07–24.82 seconds:

Enter the giant CD finale stage, the highest-energy section of the entire video.

The protagonist stands at the center of a rotating CD 12 meters in diameter, and 6 backup dancers form a symmetrical semicircle. The camera quickly descends from a high position to a hero angle slightly below waist level.

The protagonist lip-syncs precisely according to the song's climax section, and everyone completes the core chorus choreography:

two beats of quick arm switching;
one hip hit;
one synchronized spin;
one full-body sink;
finally the backup dancers open to both sides, completely yielding the stage center to the protagonist.

The camera circles half a turn while the protagonist spins, but must not cross the axis or cause left-right flipping.

The CD surface produces real rainbow diffraction, and the pixel starry sky and chrome planets flicker with the rhythm.

When the music suddenly empties out at 24.82 seconds, all backup dancers immediately freeze.

24.82–27.00 seconds:

The protagonist continues moving, while the backup dancers freeze in the background like lagging video game characters.

The protagonist walks two steps toward the camera alone. The image shows a restrained digital stutter effect according to the staccato in the audio: the same action briefly repeats for 1–2 frames, but the protagonist's face remains stable.

As the music continues to empty out, the frozen backup dancers turn into square pixel particles one by one and disappear.

The protagonist must not disappear, duplicate, or deform.

27.00–28.95 seconds:

Only the protagonist remains on stage.

The giant CD stops rotating, and most of the background lights go out. The camera slowly pushes in toward the protagonist's face.

The protagonist takes the mini transparent flip phone from her waist and raises it beside her face. She keeps her lips closed until the last vocal line of @Audio 1 actually begins.

The image movement becomes extremely minimal, leaving all attention to the last line and the protagonist's expression.

28.95–29.90 seconds:

The protagonist precisely lip-syncs the last line of the song.

She looks directly at the camera, gradually changing from a calm expression to a slight smile with a mischievous feel. The camera continues pushing in to a facial close-up.

Only silver-pink rim light and small square reflections in her eyes remain.

29.90–30.00 seconds:

The protagonist "snaps" the flip phone shut.

The closing action must be perfectly synchronized with the song's final ending sound. The background lights instantly go out, and the image hard-cuts to black.

Do not fade out, do not extend the final note, and do not add subtitles, logos, or extra ending shots.

[Performance and lip-sync]

Only the protagonist is allowed to lip-sync. The lip-sync must be generated based on the real voice and rhythm in @Audio 1; do not guess from text, and do not randomly open the mouth during purely instrumental sections.

The protagonist still maintains natural breathing, facial muscle movement, and stable identity during fast dancing. Expression changes need to match the music energy:

playful and confident in the first half;
dreamy and restrained after 14.02 seconds;
full of power again at 17.78 seconds;
entering title-track-level stage state at 21.07 seconds;
calm with a mischievous feel after 24.82 seconds.

[Hard constraints]

Must not change the speed, structure, or length of @Audio 1.
Must not add new background music, dialogue, or unrelated vocals.
Sound effects can only serve as very slight visual feedback and must not cover the original song.
The protagonist must maintain the same face from the first frame to the last frame.
Must not generate a clone of the protagonist or a second lead vocalist.
At most 6 backup dancers, and their faces must all be different from one another.
Prohibit character fusion, extra limbs, deformed fingers, foot sliding, incorrect reflections, clothing mutations, and random scene changes.
Prohibit garbled text, brands, trademarks, subtitles, and watermarks.

extra-898ece7d7221.zh-Hans:
一段电影感第一人称和自拍风格的夜间视频，主角是一位美丽的年轻东亚女性，深色长发扎成马尾，身穿栗色罗纹挂脖上衣、奶油色阔腿裤和黑色拖鞋。她正在参加东京直升机夜游。无水印、无标志、无文字叠加、无品牌名称。
场景1：夜晚，绿色灯光的屋顶直升机停机坪。她以自拍方式对着镜头微笑。她身后是一架白色Robinson风格直升机，螺旋桨正在旋转。背景是东京城市灯光和水面。她说自己正在东京登上直升机。
场景2：直升机驾驶舱内。她戴着带吊杆麦克风的绿色航空耳机和黑色四点式安全带。她的上衣夹着一个小型毛绒领夹麦克风。她看向镜头，略显紧张然后微笑，调整安全带。透过敞开的侧面可见夜晚城市灯光。
场景3：直升机从停机坪起飞。夜晚东京湾的广角视野，左侧东京塔发出橙色光芒，右侧彩虹大桥灯火通明，下方是深色水面。
场景4：敞门直升机飞行。强风吹动她的头发。她兴奋地大笑，眯着眼睛，开心地张着嘴，说根本没有门。下方：水面上的一艘货船和闪烁的城市天际线。
场景5：POV从她双腿之间向下看——奶油色裤子和黑色凉鞋悬在密集的东京摩天大楼和夜晚发光街道的海洋上方。
场景6：在灯火通明的橙色东京塔旁近距离自拍。她看着镜头说“That’s Tokyo Tower.”（“那是东京塔。”）
场景7：航拍飞越发出紫白光芒的东京晴空塔，画面底部可见她的脚，下方是高速公路和密集的城市灯光。
场景8：夜晚沿彩虹大桥低空飞行——白色缆索、亮着车灯的汽车、身后的城市天际线。
场景9：降落后，她从白色直升机上走下，踏上绿色停机坪，一手拿着耳机朝镜头走来，穿着同样的服装。
场景10：她现在站在夜晚拥挤的涩谷十字路口，到处都是霓虹招牌，身后有黄色出租车和过马路的人群。她对着镜头微笑，挥手，说“Alright everyone, bye!”（“好了大家，拜拜！”）然后说“Bye!”（“拜拜！”）
